content.title: Logistic Properties of the Americas authorizes 12-month $10M share repurchase
content.summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a 12-month share repurchase program o buy back up to $10M of the Company’s outstanding ordinary shares, effective November 22 . Under this program, LPA may repurchase its shares from time to time, based on equity market conditions, legal requirements, and other corporate considerations, under a 10b5-1 plan or similar trading arrangement.
